bio: The Soho Hotel is a stylish hotel located in the heart of the West End. It is surrounded by some of London's best restaurants and bars, vibrant cafes and most exciting theatre and nightlife.  You can enjoy Afternoon Tea in the chic Refuel Bar and Restaurant, which was designed by owner Kit Kemp and features a colourful mural by London born artist Alexander Hollweg which spans the length of the Oak and Pewter bar.  Sit back and enjoy your Best of British Afternoon Tea, which celebrates the best seasonal produce from the British Isles and comprises a selection of cakes and pastries, freshly baked scones and an assortment of Afternoon Tea savouries.  Please note that each guest dining must order Afternoon Tea. One Afternoon Tea cannot be shared between two or more guests.
